German has been living in Norway for a year and runs up with tourists up to three times a week. Most come for the photo on the edge of the rock, which drops 604 meters steeply into the fjord. When the weather is good, creeping is guaranteed here. To avoid this, Åsmund Bakke only offers tours in small groups on the follow-up gefonna glacier in Jondal. Nevertheless, demand has increased significantly in recent years. A balancing act for the team around Åsmund, because on the one hand they live from the tourists - on the other hand, a strong increase in flight and ship trips find the climate and thus the glacier. He is director of the Bryggen Foundation in Bergen. The historic harbor district is UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the most popular places in the Kustenstadt. Martin Piehler's city -based also ends in the Basic quarter. "In July it is sometimes so full that you can hardly walk," said Piehler. And not everyone behaves respectfully. According to Øyen, there are currently discussion of the visitor limitation. Some residents in the small town of Flåm am Aurlandsfjord were probably pleased about a visitor limitation. Especially on days on which a cruise ship is located in the harbor, the 288-soul village becomes the purest Disneyland. One of the main rounds: nature and the Flåmbahn. It is considered one of the most beautiful train trips in the world and ensures that up to 450,000 tourists come to Flåm. Yvonne, Robert and son Paul are also here. But is the still natural, relaxed trip? The "ZDF. Reportage" accompanies German campers and tourists on their journey through Sudnorwegen and shows how the locals experience the tourist rush. / Norwegen statt Malle. Immer mehr Touristen reisen in den Norden, denn am Mittelmeer wird es im Sommer immer heiSSer. Droht dem Norden jetzt der Übertourismus?2024 war mit fast 38,6 Millionen Übernachtungen fur Norwegen ein Rekordjahr. Temperaturen von 18 bis 25 Grad, eine Vielzahl an Campingmoglichkeiten, Kulinarik, Kultur, Nightlife und einzigartige Wanderziele sind verlockend - aber der Ansturm birgt auch Konflikte.Bei Per Arne Haarr auf dem Campingplatz in Stavanger ist es in der Hauptsaison normal, dass er und sein Team ab dem fruhen Nachmittag Touristen abweisen mussen. Reservieren kann man auf dem Platz mitten in der Stadt nicht. Auch deswegen sind Robert, Yvonne und Sohn Paul extra fruh angereist. Die Familie aus dem Schwarzwald ist das zweite Mal in Norwegen. "Das erste Mal haben wir eine Tour mit dem Motorrad ans Nordkap gemacht", so Yvonne. Dieses Mal mochten sie die Hotspots im Suden erleben. Doch schnell zeigt sich, dort ist es mittlerweile um einiges voller als vor sechs Jahren.Einsamkeit in der Natur Norwegens sucht man hier vergebens. Wer Trubel mag, kommt aber in den Kneipenmeilen, der so genannten Fargegatan und an der Hafenpromenade, voll auf seine Kosten. Dazu kommen die Kreuzfahrtschiffe. Bis zu drei davon konnen in Stavanger gleichzeitig liegen und schwemmen so taglich tausende Touristen in die Stadt.Sehr zum Leidwesen von Anwohnern wie Knut und Ingrid. Sie wohnen in der Altstadt, dem so genannten Gamle Stavanger. Jeden Tag von Mai bis Oktober liegen Schiffe vor ihrer Haustur."Ich stehe morgens schon mit einem beklemmenden Gefuhl auf", erzahlt Ingrid. Die Schiffe direkt vor ihrer Haustur seien nicht nur schlecht fur ihre Aussicht, sondern auch fur die historischen Gebaude und ihre Gesundheit.Wie voll es wirklich werden kann, zeigt sich nur 40 Minuten von Stavanger entfernt. Hier liegt der Preikestolen - Beichtstuhl zu Deutsch. Der beruhmte Fels ist auch das Ziel von Yvonne und Robert. Sie machen eine Tour mit Melanie Uhl. Die Deutsche lebt seit einem Jahr in Norwegen und lauft bis zu dreimal die Woche mit Touristen hier hoch. Die meisten kommen fur das Foto am Rand des Felsens, der 604 Meter steil in den Fjord abfallt. Bei gutem Wetter ist Schlangestehen hier garantiert.Um das zu vermeiden, bietet Åsmund Bakke auf dem Folgefonna-Gletscher in Jondal nur Touren in kleinen Gruppen an. Trotzdem ist die Nachfrage in den letzten Jahren stark gestiegen. Fur das Team um Åsmund ein Balanceakt, denn zum einen leben sie von den Touristen - zum anderen gefahrdet ein starker Anstieg von Flug- und Schiffsreisen das Klima und somit den Gletscher.Die richtige Balance finden, ist auch das Thema von Bernt Hårvard Øyen. Er ist Direktor der Stiftung Bryggen in Bergen. Das historische Hafenviertel ist UNESCO Weltkulturerbe und einer der beliebtesten Orte in der Kustenstadt. Auch die Stadtfuhrung von Martin Piehler endet in dem beruhmten Viertel. "Im Juli ist es hier manchmal so voll, dass man kaum laufen kann", so Piehler. Und nicht alle benehmen sich respektvoll. Laut Øyen wird derzeit uber Moglichkeiten der Besucherbegrenzung diskutiert.Über eine Besucherbegrenzung wurde sich wohl mancher Anwohner in dem kleinen Stadtchen Flåm am Aurlandsfjord freuen. Gerade an Tagen, an denen ein Kreuzfahrtschiff im Hafen liegt, wird aus dem 288-Seelen-Dorf das reinste Disneyland. Einer der Hauptgrunde: die Natur und die Flåmbahn. Sie gilt als eine der schonsten Zugreisen der Welt und sorgt dafur, dass bis zu 450.000 Touristen nach Flåm kommen. Auch Yvonne, Robert und Sohn Paul sind deswegen hier. Doch ist das noch naturnahes, entspanntes Reisen?Die "ZDF.reportage" begleitet deutsche Camper und Touristen auf ihrer Reise durch Sudnorwegen und zeigt, wie die Einheimischen den Touristenansturm erleben.

programme.desc: Better Backs 2024/25. The goals are just as important as repulsions, so we remember the best interventions of La Liga goalkeepers. We look back on the top bumps every month, giving them the importance they deserve. / Καλύτερες Αποκρούσεις 2024/25. Τα γκολ είναι εξίσου σημαντικά με τις αποκρούσεις και γι αυτό θυμόμαστε τις καλύτερες επεμβάσεις των τερματοφυλάκων της La Liga. programme.title: Football: Mallorca - Barcelona (G) / Ποδόσφαιρο: Μαγιόρκα - Μπαρτσελόνα (Ζ)
programme.desc: La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Mallorca welcomes Barcelona at the La Liga premiere. The islanders want to start dynamically, while Barcelona returns with the aim of defending her title, with Lamin Yamal at the forefront. Description: G. Doussas / La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Η Μαγιόρκα υποδέχεται τη Μπαρτσελόνα στην πρεμιέρα της La Liga. Οι νησιώτες θέλουν να ξεκινήσουν δυναμικά, ενώ η Μπαρτσελόνα επιστρέφει με στόχο να υπερασπιστεί τον τίτλο της, με τον Λαμίν Γιαμάλ στην πρώτη γραμμή. Περιγραφή: Γ. Δούσκας

programme.title: Football: Alaves - Levante (G) / Ποδόσφαιρο: Αλαβές - Λεβάντε (Ζ)
programme.desc: La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Alaves welcomes Levante at the La Liga premiere. The Basque finished 17th, securing their stay at the last minute, while Levante returns to the first division as a Segunda champion. Description: El Vlach / La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Η Αλαβές υποδέχεται τη Λεβάντε στην πρεμιέρα της La Liga. Οι Βάσκοι τερμάτισαν 17οι εξασφαλίζοντας την παραμονή τους την τελευταία στιγμή, ενώ η Λεβάντε επιστρέφει στην πρώτη κατηγορία ως πρωταθλήτρια της Segunda. Περιγραφή: Ηλ. Βλάχος

programme.title: Spanish football championship / Ισπανικό Πρωτάθλημα Ποδοσφαίρου
programme.desc: Episode: The team of the season 2024/25. The season awards are organized by Laliga and EA Sports and highlight the 15 best players of the season. The winners are selected by the team leaders, a committee of experts and the sporting public. / Επεισόδιο: Η Ομάδα της Σεζόν 2024/25. Τα βραβεία Ομάδα της Σεζόν διοργανώνονται από τη LALIGA και την EA SPORTS και αναδεικνύουν τους 15 καλύτερους ποδοσφαιριστές της σεζόν. Οι νικητές επιλέγονται από τους αρχηγούς των ομάδων, μία επιτροπή ειδικών και το φίλαθλο κοινό.

programme.title: The History of Rain E3 (E) / Η Ιστορία της Βροχής Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The value of the rain. Life on Earth would not be possible without rain. Although water covers most of the earth, 97% of it is seafood. The rain supports life on land by providing salt -free water that we can drink. / Επεισόδιο: Η Αξία της Βροχής. Η ζωή στη Γη δεν θα ήταν δυνατή χωρίς βροχή. programme.title: In the islands of Italy E4 (E) / Στα Νησιά της Ιταλίας Ε4 (Ε)

programme.title: In the footsteps of the Greeks of Egypt E3 (E) / Στα Χνάρια των Ελλήνων της Αιγύπτου Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Pyramids, Nile and Saint George. programme.title: Box: Castro - Oumiha / Boks: Castro - Oumiha
programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Football - Mozzart Bet Superliga: Mladost - Red Star / Fudbal - Mozzart Bet Superliga: Mladost - Crvena zvezda
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the sub-circuit principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the Red-White Titles to the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcioniše po dvokružnom principu takmičenju. Istoriju Superlige u najvećoj meri su obeležila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Istorijski gledano, po broju osvojenih titula crveno-beli do grada je uspešniji.

programme.title: Football - English League: Liverpool - Bournemouth / Fudbal - Engleska liga: Liverpool - Bournemouth
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: They love Serbia / Oni vole Srbiju
programme.desc: The number of players and coaches who found its happiness in Serbia is not small. They belong to different branches of sports, and they could have been convinced here how true the famous Serbian hospitality stories are true. Some of them found the love of your life here, found homes, friends for all life, get citizenship. What is their attitude towards Serbia and what their life is, find out in our show. / Broj igrača i trenera koji je svoju sreću pronašao u Srbiji nije mali. Oni pripadaju različitim granama sporta, a ovde su mogli da se uvere koliko su priče o čuvenom srpskom gostoprimstvu istinite. Neki od njih su ovde pronašli ljubav svog života, pronašli kumove, prijatelje za ceo život, dobili državljanstvo. programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Mallorca - Barcelona / Fudbal - Španska liga: Mallorca - Barcelona
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Dubai - Cedevita Olympia G3 / Košarka - ABA liga: Dubai - Cedevita Olimpija G3

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Lugano, Qualifications for Conference League 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Lugano, Kvalifikacije za Konferenčno ligo 2025/2026
programme.desc: Since 2021, football fans will enjoy the conference league of Europe organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. The winner of the final game will qualify for the European League next season. / Od leta 2021 bodo nogometni navdušenci uživali v Konferenčni ligi Evrope, ki jo organizira UEFA. Ideja za to ligo se je pojavila leta 2015, vključuje pa nižje rangirane ekipe državnih prvenstev. Kvalifikacije so razdeljene na dva dela, po katerih bo v tekmovanje vstopilo 32 ekip, ki bodo razdeljene v osem skupin po štiri. 16 ekip bo napredovalo v osmino finala, nato v četrtfinale, polfinale in finale. Zmagovalec finalne tekme se bo uvrstil v Ligo Evrope v naslednji sezoni.

programme.title: Cycling: Arctic Race in Norway: Vrhni / Kolesarstvo: Arktična dirka po Norveški: Vrhunci
programme.desc: The Arctic race in Norway is a professional stage race on the road bike. The race takes place every year in northern Norway. The idea of an Arctic race in Norway - an international race in three northern Norway districts - was created in Andørja in Troms, August 2013. / Arktična dirka po Norveški je profesionalna etapna dirka na cestnem kolesu. Dirka vsako leto poteka na severu Norveške. Zamisel o arktični dirki na Norveškem - mednarodni dirki v treh najsevernejših okrožjih Norveške - je nastala v Andørji v Tromsu, avgusta 2013.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Lugano, Qualifications for Conference League 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Lugano, Kvalifikacije za Konferenčno ligo 2025/2026
programme.desc: Since 2021, football fans will enjoy the conference league of Europe organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. The winner of the final game will qualify for the European League next season. / Od leta 2021 bodo nogometni navdušenci uživali v Konferenčni ligi Evrope, ki jo organizira UEFA. Ideja za to ligo se je pojavila leta 2015, vključuje pa nižje rangirane ekipe državnih prvenstev. Kvalifikacije so razdeljene na dva dela, po katerih bo v tekmovanje vstopilo 32 ekip, ki bodo razdeljene v osem skupin po štiri. 16 ekip bo napredovalo v osmino finala, nato v četrtfinale, polfinale in finale. Zmagovalec finalne tekme se bo uvrstil v Ligo Evrope v naslednji sezoni.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Let's bite science: learning with movement, Mon. / Ugriznimo znanost: Učenje z gibanjem, pon.
programme.desc: R: Vilar Mile ... Research has shown that more powerful children at school have better success. The golden graduates are similar to top athletes in terms of movement skills. The movement therefore helps us to learn. Today, the amount of knowledge is increasing, so we are looking for new ways to learn effectively. One of them is learning with movement. Physical activity has a profound effect on brain function. As we move, our brains receive more blood and nutrients, which strengthens the connections between different brain centers. We will show you how students, students and students as well as dramatic players learn successfully. / R: Vilar Mile... Raziskave so pokazale, da imajo telesno zmogljivejši otroci v šoli boljši uspeh. Zlati maturanti so po gibalnih sposobnostih podobni vrhunskim športnikom. Gibanje nam torej pomaga pri učenju. Danes je količina znanja čedalje večja, zato iščemo nove načine za učinkovito učenje. Eden izmed njih je učenje z gibanjem. Telesna dejavnost močno vpliva na delovanje možganov. Ko se gibamo, prejemajo naši možgani več krvi in hranil, kar krepi povezave med različnimi možganskimi centri. Pokazali vam bomo, kako se uspešno učijo učenci, dijaki in študentje in tudi dramski igralci.

programme.title: Listen!, Documentary Felts, Mon. / Poslušaj!, dokumentarni feljton, pon.
programme.desc: R: Primoz Meško ... Listen to the documentary foelon! It shows the shocking story of musician Milan Ostojic, who, thirty years ago, together with his family, came from Croatia to Slovenia. In a hurry to escape before the war, they were left without documents. The film narrative reveals their twenty -year efforts to obtain permanent residence and find a new home. In the fight for survival, they were helped by music. The Halgato band, founded by Milan Ostojic, still performs at concerts today. Listen! Not only is an invitation to listen to their emotionally expressive music. Listen! It is a rotating request for some refugees to listen to them with understanding. Screenplay Cvetka Bevc, directed by Primož Meško, director of photography and cameraman Andrej Lupinc. Production of the editorial board of documentary broadcasts TV Slovenia, cultural and art program, editor -in -chief Andraž Poschl. / R: Primož Meško... Dokumentarni feljton POSLUŠAJ! prikazuje pretresljivo zgodbo o glasbeniku Milana Ostojiću, ki je pred tridesetimi leti skupaj z družino prišel iz Hrvaške v Slovenijo. V naglici bega pred vojno vihro so ostali brez dokumentov. Filmska pripoved razkriva njihovo dvajset let trajajoče prizadevanje za pridobitev stalnega prebivališča in iskanje novega doma. V boju za preživetje jim je pomagala glasba. Halgato band, ki ga je ustanovil Milan Ostojić, še danes nastopa na koncertih. Poslušaj! ni le vabilo k poslušanju njihove emocionalno ekspresivne glasbe. Poslušaj! je roteča prošnja prenekaterih beguncev, da jim z razumevanjem prisluhnemo. Scenarij Cvetka Bevc, režija Primož Meško, direktor fotografije in snemalec Andrej Lupinc. Produkcija Uredništvo dokumentarnih oddaj TV Slovenija, Kulturni in umetniški program, odgovorni urednik Andraž Poschl.

programme.title: Automotive: In practice, we tried an autonomous ride, Mon. / Avtomobilnost: V praksi smo preizkusili avtonomno vožnjo, pon.
programme.sub-title: Oddaja bo v celoti posvečena avtonomni vožnji. Poročamo o dveh vožnjah z avtonomnima avtomobiloma. Seveda ju nismo vozili, peljali pa smo se in to po Evropi.
programme.desc: In the UK, we sat in Nissan Leaf, which has more than 25,000 autonomous miles on the highway, including through London. She impressed driving on local roads at a hundred miles per hour. The car automatically drove us dynamically, on public roads, behaving and deciding as a competent driver. At the French racetrack, the "self -driving" Toyota Yaris Gru drove us even more dynamically, even racing. In both cases, engineers told us that the aim of the project is to imitate human behavior. At the wheel, we also learned powerful assistive systems, in the infamous Tesla Model Y and in the European car of the year Renault Scenic. / V Veliki Britaniji smo sedli v Nissana Leafa, ki ima za sabo že več kot 25.000 avtonomnih kilometrov po avtocesti, tudi skozi London. Navdušila je vožnja po lokalnih cestah pri sto kilometrih na uro. Avto nas je samodejno vozil dinamično, po javnih cestah in se pri tem obnašal ter odločal kot kompetenten voznik.Na francoskem dirkališču nas je »samovozeča« Toyota Yaris GR zapeljala še bolj dinamično, celo dirkaško. V obeh primerih so nam inženirji povedali, da je cilj projektov posnemati človeško vedenje. Za volanom smo spoznali tudi zmogljive asistenčne sisteme in sicer v zloglasni Tesli modela Y ter v evropskem avtu leta Renaultu Scenicu.

programme.desc: It has grown important religious landmarks for the three largest monotheistic religions. So today Jews can pray in front of the wall of mourning, the last remnant of the old temple. Za muslimane pa Kupola na skali hrani najpomembnejši odlomek iz Korana. Dokumentarna oddaja prikaže, kako so te najsvetejše stavbe v Jeruzalemu gradili, da so lahko uspešno kljubovale času, potresom in vojnam ter se ohranile vse do danes.JERUSALEM, BUILDERS OF THE HOLY CITY / JÉRUSALEM, LA CONSTRUCTION DE LA CITÉ DE DIEU / Francija / 2022 / Režija: Guilain Depardieu.

programme.title: Cankar, documentary feature film, Mon. / Cankar, dokumentarno igrani film, pon.
programme.sub-title: Dokumentarno-igrani film Cankar nam v igranih prizorih približa zasebno življenje največjega slovenskega pisatelja.
programme.desc: The film narrative begins in November 1899, when Ivan Cankar hires a cabinet on the Loffler family in the Vienna suburb of Ottakring. At first she approaches the gentlemen, and later her growing daughters Steffi. They have settled down for almost ten years and creates most of his works there. On his visit to his brother Karl in Sarajevo, he is the guest of Archbishop Josip Stadler. He writes the servants there and decides not to return to the fiancé in Vienna. The following years he lives on Ljubljana Rožnik. He also gets involved with the girls there; He is an attentive lover, sociable and extremely intelligent. It fools the misery of an impoverished working class around him and is impressed for social democracy. The rebellion against the criminal social order is translated by the entire Cankar's oeuvre. The reconstructions of some public appearances in the film emphasizes the power and actuality of his political word. In terms of reading Cankar's works, he reveals details from the writer's life. In his almost film descriptions, we recognize the spaces, portraits of loved ones and contemporaries. Many of what he described in the literature had experienced a few years later. In the thoughtful interweaving of playful, animated and documentary, manuscripts and letters from his legacy are woven into play scenes. The heroes in the film speak with words from Cankar's prose. The Film raises the question of how the myth of Ivan Cankar has formed in a good century. The magnificent oeuvre of novels, stories, lines, poems, essays, political speeches, articles and letters offers a wide field of interpretations. Cankar was appropriated both on the left and right. In the documentary, we face connoisseurs who passionately reveal the overlooked side of the writer's work. We are convinced that we have learned everything about Cankar in a good century, but we really only know his work superficially. / Filmska pripoved se začne novembra 1899, ko Ivan Cankar najame kabinet pri družini Loffler v dunajskem predmestju Ottakring. Sprva se približa gospodinji, pozneje pa njeni odraščajoči hčeri Steffi. Pri njih se ustali za skoraj deset let in tam ustvari večino svojih del.Ob obisku brata Karla v Sarajevu je gost nadškofa Josipa Stadlerja. Tam napiše Hlapce in se odloči, da se ne bo vrnil k zaročenki na Dunaj. Naslednja leta živi na ljubljanskem Rožniku. Tudi tam se zapleta s tamkajšnjimi dekleti; je pozoren ljubimec, družaben in izjemno inteligenten.Opazuje bedo obubožanega delavskega razreda okoli sebe in se navduši za socialdemokracijo. Upor proti krivičnemu družbenemu redu preveva celoten Cankarjev opus. Z rekonstrukcijami nekaterih javnih nastopov v filmu je poudarjena moč in aktualnost njegove politične besede.Pozorno branje Cankarjevih del nam razkriva podrobnosti iz pisateljevega življenja. V njegovih skoraj filmskih opisih prepoznavamo prostore, portrete najbližjih in sodobnikov. Marsikaj, kar je opisal v literaturi, je nekaj let pozneje tudi sam doživel. V premišljenih prepletih igranega, animiranega in dokumentarnega so rokopisi in pisma iz njegove zapuščine vtkani v igrane prizore. Junaki v filmu spregovorijo z besedami iz Cankarjeve proze.Film odpira vprašanje, kako se je v dobrem stoletju izoblikoval mit o Ivanu Cankarju. Veličasten opus romanov, povesti, črtic, pesmi, esejev, političnih govorov, člankov in pisem ponuja široko polje interpretacij. Cankarja so si prisvajali tako na levici kot na desnici. V dokumentarnem delu filma se srečujemo s poznavalci, ki strastno razkrivajo prezrte plati pisateljevega dela. Prepričani smo, da smo o Cankarju v dobrem stoletju izvedeli vse, vendar njegovo delo v resnici le površno poznamo.

programme.title: Imago Sloveniae: Barcelona Gipsy Klezmer Orchestra and Vlado Kreslin, Mon. / Imago Sloveniae: Barcelona Gipsy Klezmer Orchestra in Vlado Kreslin, pon.
programme.desc: R: Menart Urška ... A large family of nomadic musicians coming from different countries of Europe (Catalonia, Turkey, Serbia, India, Italy, France, Switzerland, Greece) met in Barcelona in 2010. Introduce expertise and influences of other music genres. This made strong creative bonds between them, on the basis of which the Barcelona Gipsy Klezmer Orchestra (BGKO) was formed. With excellent interpretations and energy spreading among the audience, they are impressed by a wide variety of music venues across Europe. It was also brought to the City Square of Ljubljana in 2013 at the opening of the 25th night in Old Ljubljana, prepared by the Imago Sloveniae Foundation - the image of Slovenia. As a guest, one of the greatest Slovenian singers, Vlado Kreslin, joined them on stage! / R: Menart Urška... Velika družina nomadskih glasbenikov, ki prihajajo iz različnih držav Evrope (Katalonija,Turčija, Srbija, Indija, Italija, Francija, Švica, Grčija), se je srečala v Barceloni leta 2010. Izhodišče njihovega skupnega ustvarjanja so bila glasbena druženja, na katerih so v improviziranem igranju združevali in delili svojo strast do tradicionalne judovske in romske glasbe, v katero so vnašali strokovno znanje in vplive drugih glasbenih zvrsti. To je med njimi stkalo močne ustvarjalne vezi, na podlagi katerih se je oblikovala skupina Barcelona Gipsy Klezmer Orchestra (BGKO). Z odličnimi interpretacijami in energijo, ki jo širijo med občinstvo, navdušujejo na najrazličnejših glasbenih prizoriščih po Evropi. Prinesli so jo tudi na Mestni trg Ljubljane leta 2013 ob odprtju 25. Noči v Stari Ljubljani, ki jih pripravlja ustanova Imago Sloveniae – Podoba Slovenije. Na odru se jim je kot gost pridružil eden največjih slovenskih kantavtorjev, Vlado Kreslin!

programme.title: Reverse, documentary film, pon. / Reverz, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Frelih Anton... Po drugi svetovni vojni je Slovenija sprejela odlok o ustanovitvi Federalnega zbirnega centra.
programme.desc: Special commissions have "selected" valuable objects (art paintings and statues, ancient furniture, carpets, porcelain, instruments and more) throughout the country. In Ljubljana, a collection center with three warehouses operated in Ljubljana, and three more area branches in Celje, Maribor and Novo mesto. It was a form of nationalization, which at that time was accompanied by an apology that he was taking war criminals and thus ensuring the preservation of these objects in Slovenia. But many objects were taken by the people of Slovenia with a purely "clear" war of the past, only they had too much for the concepts of the time. Thus, the excuse to preserve the cultural heritage in Slovenia by nationalization was quite empty. Private property was roughly trampled. He finished some of the confiscated subjects in the then government and ministerial premises, art galleries, museums and schools, and ended up a considerable part of the subjects in the hands of important, for the time of the deserving individuals who were at the top of the political structure. The screenwriter and director of the documentary is Tone Frelih. / Posebne komisije so po deželi »odbirale« vredne predmete (umetniške slike in kipe, antično pohištvo, preproge, porcelan, glasbila in drugo). V Ljubljani je delovala centrala zbirnega centra s tremi skladišči, po Sloveniji pa še tri področne izpostave, v Celju, Mariboru in Novem mestu. Šlo je za obliko nacionalizacije, ki jo je takratna oblast pospremila z opravičilom, da jemlje vojni zločincem in da na ta način zagotavlja ohranitev teh predmetov v Sloveniji. Toda veliko predmetov je bilo vzetih prebivalcem Slovenije s povsem »čisto« vojno preteklostjo, le imeli so preveč za takratne pojme. Tako je bil izgovor, da z nacionalizacijo ohranjajo kulturno dediščino v Sloveniji, precej prazen. Zasebna lastnina je bila grobo poteptana. Del tako zaplenjenih predmetov je dokumentirano končal v takratnih vladnih in ministrskih prostorih , umetniških galerijah, muzejih in šolah, precejšen del predmetov pa je končal v rokah pomembnih, za takratni čas zaslužnih posameznikov, ki so bili v vrhu politične strukture.Danes lahko pretežni del dokumentacije o ustanovitvi in delovanju Federalnega zbirnega centra ter o zaplenjenih predmetih najdemo v Arhivu Republike Slovenije. Scenarist in režiser dokumentarnega filma je Tone Frelih.

programme.title: Gold rush in Alaska / Goldrausch in Alaska
programme.desc: Parker Schnabel has set itself ambitious goals this year. The treasure hunter wants to quickly advance to gold in the Klondike before he puts his new mine into operation in Alaska. But the frozen shower material does not get the car wash. Fred Lewis and his team cattle in the nearby Dawson City with similar problems. A layer of ice, which is ten meters thick, blocks the way to the precious metal. And how do the Clayton brother do? Brandon and Brady want to ask 500 ounces to repay family debt. The wild west was yesterday, but the gold fever is back. With a fixed goal in mind, six men in the wilderness of Alaska take their fate into their own hands: on a separated Claim near the Canadian border, they want to shrink for gold. Together with his father Jack, a real gold rush veteran, Todd Hoffman gathered a handful of motivated man. The hope for wealth, fame and fist -sized nuggets drives them to high performance. But what depends on the wildly romantic realization of a childhood dream is a tough work paired with high risk: wild barn, extreme weather and bitter exchanges await the treasure hunters in a god -forgiving area. / Parker Schnabel hat sich in diesem Jahr ehrgeizige Ziele gesetzt. Der Schatzsucher will im Klondike moglichst schnell bis zum Gold vorstossen, bevor er in Alaska seine neue Mine in Betrieb nimmt. Aber das gefrorene Schurfmaterial bekommt der Waschanlage nicht. Fred Lewis und sein Team kampfen in der Nahe von Dawson City mit ahnlichen Problemen. Ein zehn Meter dicke Eisschicht versperrt den Mannern den Weg zum Edelmetall. Und wie schlagen sich die Clayton-Bruder? Brandon und Brady wollen 500 Unzen ans Tageslicht befordern, um Familienschulden zu tilgen.Der Wilde Westen war gestern, doch das Goldfieber ist zuruck. Mit einem festen Ziel vor Augen, nehmen sechs Manner in der Wildnis Alaskas ihr Schicksal selbst in die Hand: Auf einem abgeschiedenen Claim nahe der kanadischen Grenze wollen sie nach Gold schurfen. Zusammen mit seinem Vater Jack, einem echten Goldrausch-Veteran, hat Todd Hoffman eine Handvoll motivierter Manner um sich versammelt. Die Hoffnung auf Reichtum, Ruhm und faustgrosse Nuggets treibt sie dabei zu Hochstleistungen an. Doch was sich nach der wildromantischen Verwirklichung eines Kindheitstraums anhort, ist knuppelharte Arbeit gepaart mit hohem Risiko: Wildlebende Baren, extreme Witterung und herbe Enttauschungen warten auf die Schatzsucher in einer gottverlassenen Gegend.

programme.title: The treasure hunters - gold divers of the Beringsee / Die Schatzsucher - Goldtaucher der Beringsee
programme.desc: Windbos of up to 40 knots, strong surf, fog and icy subsequent temperatures at night: A storm at the end of the summer season puts the gold fever of the Alaskan fleet on a hard sample. In the center of this documentary series, the custody of the Beringsee is in the US state of Alaska. During the small custy city of Nome there is calm every year for nine months because the port is frozen, the thirst for adventure breaks out in summer when treasure divers from all over the world go on a gold search there. The area is based on its gold deposits, which have been washed up over millions of years by the melt water of the glaciers. With heavy rats and huge hydraulic suckers, the experts search for the seabed. The exhausting expeditions are not unusual and very few do the big Reibach. / Windboen von bis zu 40 Knoten, starke Brandung, Nebel und eisige Minustemperaturen bei Nacht: Ein Unwetter am Ende der Sommersaison stellt das Goldfieber der alaskischen Flotte auf eine harte Probe.Im Mittelpunkt dieser Dokumentarserie steht die Kuste der Beringsee im US-Bundesstaat Alaska. Wahrend in dem kleinen Kustenstadtchen Nome jedes Jahr neun Monate lang Ruhe herrscht, weil der Hafen zugefroren ist, bricht im Sommer die Abenteuerlust aus, wenn sich Schatztaucher aus der ganzen Welt dort auf Goldsuche begeben. Die Gegend ist beruhmt fur ihre Goldvorkommen, die uber Millionen Jahre vom Schmelzwasser der Gletscher angeschwemmt wurden. Mit schwerem Gerat und riesigen hydraulischen Saugern suchen die Experten den Meeresgrund ab. Die aufwandigen Expeditionen sind nicht ungefahrlich und nur die Wenigsten machen den grossen Reibach.

programme.title: Evangelical - with God to power / Evangelikale - Mit Gott an die Macht
programme.desc: In the beginning was Billy Graham. In the middle of the Cold War, the charismatic preacher fascinated the masses around the world as well as the ruling elites in Washington. He became the “Pope” of the evangelicals and helped this new Christian movement to an enormous upswing. On his travels around the globe, he turned to the newly recognized words and thus started a missionary dynamics that were increasingly moving to act in the service of God. Soon on all continents of Mega -Churches, from Sudkorea Uber Nigeria to Brazil, new religious managers were successful, which Billy Graham had spent - and gave their spiritual struggle an even more radical orientation. How has the evangelicals succeeded in enforcing their new moral order and wherever they come to the government, the separation of spiritual and secular, worldly, to question religion and politics? How can this ultra -conservative change be explained in the middle of a supposedly sacularized world? A film by Thomas Johnson and Philippe Gonzalezwerrwärzung of October 22, 2023 / Am Anfang war Billy Graham. Mitten im Kalten Krieg faszinierte der charismatische Prediger die Massen auf der ganzen Welt ebenso wie die herrschenden Eliten in Washington. Er wurde zum «Papst» der Evangelikalen und verhalf dieser neuen christlichen Bewegung zu einem enormen Aufschwung. Auf seinen Reisen um den Globus wandte er sich in einfachen Worten an die Neubekehrten und brachte so eine Missionierungsdynamik in Gang, die immer mehr Menschen dazu bewegte, sich in den Dienst Gottes zu stellen. Bald wimmelte es auf allen Kontinenten von Mega-Churches, von Sudkorea uber Nigeria bis Brasilien ernteten neue religiose Fuhrer erfolgreich, was Billy Graham gesat hatte - und gaben ihrem spirituellen Kampf eine noch radikalere Ausrichtung.Wie ist es den Evangelikalen gelungen, ihre neue moralische Ordnung durchzusetzen und uberall dort, wo sie an die Regierung kommen, die Trennung von Geistlichem und Weltlichem, von Religion und Politik in Frage zu stellen? Wie lasst sich dieser ultrakonservative Umschwung inmitten einer vermeintlich sakularisierten Welt erklaren?Ein Film von Thomas Johnson und Philippe GonzalezWiederholung vom 22. Oktober 2023

programme.title: The power of the feeling - from fear to anger / Die Macht der Gefuhle - von Angst bis Zorn
programme.desc: Fear of the climate crisis, anger on the elites, hatred of strangers. Geating make politics. And they steer us humans in everyday life, often unnoticed. That is why you should pay attention to them, but feelings should not have the last word, says the philosopher Dominik Perler, professor at the Humboldt university to Berlin. In conversation with Yves Bossart, he explains why evolutionary fear of snakes is still helpful today, even if you should be more afraid of sugar, fat or of social media. And he shows what feelings about us people reveal how minds and feelings are related and why love relationships with AI-Avatars are problematic. Redance of June 1, 2025 / Angst vor der Klimakrise, Wut auf die Eliten, Hass gegenuber Fremden. Gefuhle machen Politik. Und sie lenken uns Menschen im Alltag, oft unbemerkt. Darum sollte man auf sie achten, aber Gefuhle sollten nicht das letzte Wort haben, meint der Philosoph Dominik Perler, Professor an der Humboldt-Universitat zu Berlin.Im Gesprach mit Yves Bossart erklart er, warum die evolutionare Angst vor Schlangen heute noch hilfreich ist, auch wenn man eher Angst vor Zucker, Fett oder vor Social Media haben sollte. Und er zeigt auf, was Gefuhle uber uns Menschen verraten, wie Verstand und Gefuhl zusammenhangen und warum Liebesbeziehungen zu KI-Avataren problematisch sind.Wiederholung vom 1. Juni 2025

programme.title: Police Wackerli / Polizischt Wackerli
programme.desc: Gottfried Wackerli, as a cantonal police officer in the municipality of Allenwil, has his service. But one day the well -behaved lawyer comes into arguments with its professional conscience and with its floats. Criminal offenses throw shadows on his own family. Hans Bader, a friend of his daughter Marty and assistant to Milchmann Buttikofer, is said to have stolen 50 francs to his master. And Wackerli's own son Ruedi, who is incredible in teaching and can do money poorly, is even suspected of having stolen CHF 10,000 from the municipal treasury. After a family dispute, Ruedi is fed up with the mistrust of the father and leaves his mother's horror. He receives quarters in the Zurcher Niederdorf, unfolds his talent as a decorator in the Cherie bar and is robbed by the shady Hoffmann. Police officer Wackerli has all the muke to put light into the dark of the provincial affara, into which allwil's community treasurer Haberli is involved. But he manages, and he also manages to print an eye as a legal representative in the right place, to forgive the Milchmann Bader and to recognize his son Ruedi's artistic theaters.1949 Switzerland got into the "Wackerli" fever. Schaggi Streuli and Albert Welti's Horpiel series around the Bieder-Brave village policeman, who as a overfather, and at any time know the right advice and, if necessary, also became the real taster, became a street sweeper. This in turn called - with some delay, however - the film industry. Kurt Fruh, previously a respected documentary filmmaker, dealt with the solid law and created, together with Schaggi Streuli, the film "Polician Wackerli". Fruh said: «It was because we were doing something that the audience had been demanding from Swiss film for years: We wanted to show typical Swiss everyday life. Neither millions of production nor a hinterwald -based idyll were strived for. » In the end, the film cost 3,600,000 francs - and brought in 1400,000 francs: small, fine, good Swiss. To this day, the film enjoys unbroken popularity, and for Schaggi Streuli he was pioneering for his later roles like that of the female jucker in "Oberstadtgass". / Gottfried Wackerli versieht als Kantonspolizist in der Gemeinde Allenwil getreu seinen Dienst. Doch eines Tages kommt der brave Gesetzeshuter mit seinem Berufsgewissen und mit seinen Gefuhlen in argen Konflikt. Kriminalistische Delikte werfen Schatten auf seine eigene Familie. Hans Bader , ein Bekannter seiner Tochter Marty und Gehilfe bei Milchmann Buttikofer , soll seinem Meister 50 Franken gestohlen haben. Und Wackerlis eigener Sohn Ruedi , der in der Lehre unglucklich ist und Geld nur schlecht einteilen kann, wird gar verdachtigt, 10000 Franken aus der Gemeindekasse entwendet zu haben.Nach einem familiaren Disput hat Ruedi das Misstrauen des Vaters satt und verlasst das Elternhaus - zum Entsetzen seiner Mutter . Er bezieht im Zurcher Niederdorf Quartier, entfaltet in der Cherie-Bar sein Talent als Dekorateur und wird vom zwielichtigen Hoffmann bestohlen. Polizist Wackerli hat alle Muhe, Licht ins Dunkel der provinziellen Affaren zu bringen, in die nicht zuletzt Allenwils Gemeindekassier Haberli verwickelt ist. Doch er schafft es, und es gelingt ihm auch, als Rechtsvertreter am rechten Ort ein Auge zuzudrucken, dem Milchmann Bader eine Dummheit zu verzeihen und die kunstlerischen Fahigkeiten seines Sohns Ruedi anzuerkennen.1949 geriet die Schweiz ins «Wackerli»-Fieber. Die Horspielreihe von Schaggi Streuli und Albert Welti rund um den bieder-braven Dorfpolizisten, der als Übervater sein Allenwil behutet und jederzeit den rechten Rat und notfalls auch den wahren Tater kennt, wurde zum Strassenfeger. Das wiederum rief - mit einiger Verzogerung allerdings - die Filmindustrie auf den Plan. Kurt Fruh, bisher ein beachteter Dokumentarfilmer, befasste sich mit dem soliden Gesetzeshuter und schuf, zusammen mit Schaggi Streuli, den Film «Polizischt Wackerli». Fruh sagte dazu: «Es lag uns daran, etwas zu tun, was das Publikum seit Jahren vom Schweizer Film forderte: Typischen schweizerischen Alltag wollten wir zeigen. Dabei wurde weder eine Millionenproduktion noch eine hinterwaldlerische Idylle erstrebt.» 360000 Franken hat der Film am Ende gekostet - und 1400000 Franken eingebracht: klein, fein, gut schweizerisch eben. Bis heute geniesst der Film ungebrochene Popularitat, und fur Schaggi Streuli war er wegweisend fur seine spateren Rollen wie jene des Brieftragers Jucker in «Oberstadtgass».SRF 1 zeigt «Polizischt Wackerli» den Klassiker in einer digital uberarbeiteten und restaurierten Fassung.

programme.title: healthy / gesundheitheute
programme.desc: Many know his voice from documentaries, the «Rundschau» or program advertising, because Sebastian Schmid Arenas is a spokesman for Swiss television. He almost lost his life: without knowing it, he suffered from endocarditis. With this severe heart disease, the inner layer of the heart is inflicted, which can harm the heart and blood vessel. If the disease remains untreated, it often ends. But Sebastian Schmid Arenas had Gluck: his heart could be saved in a five -hour operation in the Hirslanden hospital - he was given a second life. Culture at the Bettrandder Association “Culture am Bettrand” brings cultural experiences to people who are unable to attend events. The artists appear directly in hospitals, nursing homes or at the affected people at home. These appearances are often very emotional, both for the patients as well as for their members and the artists themselves. “Healthy haute” accompanied the musician Anna Kanzig at the palliative care unit at the University Hospital in Zurich. / Viele kennen seine Stimme aus Dokumentationen, der «Rundschau» oder der Programmwerbung, denn Sebastian Schmid Arenas ist Sprecher beim Schweizer Fernsehen. Vor funf Jahren hatte er fast sein Leben verloren: Ohne es zu wissen, litt er an Endokarditis. Bei dieser schweren Herzkrankheit entzundet sich die Innenschicht des Herzens, was das Herz und die Blutgefasse schadigen kann. Wenn die Krankheit unbehandelt bleibt, endet sie oft todlich. Doch Sebastian Schmid Arenas hatte Gluck: In einer funfstundigen Operation im Spital Hirslanden konnte sein Herz gerettet werden - er bekam ein zweites Leben geschenkt.Kultur am BettrandDer Verein «Kultur am Bettrand» bringt kulturelle Erlebnisse zu Menschen, die nicht in der Lage sind, an Veranstaltungen teilzunehmen. Die Kunstschaffenden treten direkt in Spitalern, Pflegeheimen oder bei den Betroffenen zu Hause auf. Diese Auftritte sind oft sehr emotional, sowohl fur die Patientinnen und Patienten als auch fur ihre Angehorigen und die Kunstschaffenden selbst. «GESUNDHEITHEUTE» hat die Musikerin Anna Kanzig bei einem Auftritt auf der Palliativstation des Universitatsspitals Zurich begleitet.

After the outbreak of the First World War, the clever, Kuhne woman takes part in a daring trek and amazes the man's world. She is more and more lonely. In addition, she falls ill with a heavy syphilis that owes her to one of the few visits to her husband. In this difficult time, Karen gets to know and love the aristocratic globetrotter Denys Finch Hatton, a big game hunter and sports pilot. With him she experiences a large romance under African sky. But then the global economic crisis drives its coffee plantation into ruin. Karen leaves Africa forever. The promised farewell to Nairobi can no longer see Denys Finch Hatton. On the way to her he lies off with his biplan. Sydney Pollack made the Uberaus successful cinema plant in 1985 according to the novel “Africa, dark -loving world” by the Danish author Tania Blixen and received seven Oscars for this. The Africa and pioneering experience of a clever, brave woman who experiences her relationship with the black continent as a tragic marriage and love story roared. With the exotic love story, Sydney Pollack is a picture -a -view film in the style of the big cinema episans like "Gone from the Wind". In addition to Robert Redford and Klaus Maria Brandauer as a virtuoso actress, Meryl Streep is a virtuoso actress. / Am Vorabend des Ersten Weltkriegs kommt die junge Danin Karen Blixen als Herrin uber eine grosse Farm nach Ostafrika. Den Aufbau der Kaffeeplantage uberlasst er bald seiner Frau. Wahrend der Baron seinen Vergnugungen nachgeht, baut Karen mit Energie und Fleiss am Fuss der Ngongberge in Kenia eine grosse Plantage auf.Nach Ausbruch des Ersten Weltkriegs nimmt die kluge, kuhne Frau an einem waghalsigen Treck teil und versetzt die Mannerwelt in Staunen. programme.desc: Under scientific supervision, the reporter in the University Hospital Basel is injected several different doses DMT. In Switzerland, drugs such as LSD, MDMA or DMT are illegal - but the intake is allowed for scientific research. And this is booming worldwide. The hope is to enable profound, long -lasting change in mental illnesses. However, the study in which Robin participates is carried out with healthy subjects. Robin meets Sylvia Kahlo, who has lost both parents as a child and subsequently had to cattle with depression and deep trauma. It was only with the help of MDMA-stripped psychotherapy that she found access to the repressed floors. The therapeutic experience with this psychoactive substance helped her to overcome the trauma, she paids. Gregor Hasler is a neuroscientist and has been researching psychedelic substances for years. His latest study shows that psychotherapy with the support of LSD, which can actually alleviate symptoms of depression. Hasler classifies the experiences of Sylvia and Robin and explains where he sees the dangers and opportunities of such substances. / Unter wissenschaftlicher Aufsicht werden dem Reporter im Universitatsspital Basel mehrere unterschiedliche Dosen DMT injiziert. DMT ist eine der starksten psychoaktiven Substanzen, die der Mensch kennt und kommt beispielsweise in Ayahuasca vor. Binnen Sekunden wird er in eine andere Realitat katapultiert. Intensive Gefuhle, bunte, geometrische Bilder und eine vollige Orientierungslosigkeit ubermannen ihn. Die Trips sind kurz, aber tiefgreifend.«Es ist eine der starksten halluzinogenen Erfahrungen uberhaupt und diese kann sowohl als gut als auch schlecht erlebt werden», sagt Livio Erne, der die Studie leitet. Droge wie LSD, MDMA oder DMT sind in der Schweiz illegal - erlaubt ist die Einnahme aber fur die wissenschaftliche Forschung. Und diese boomt im Moment weltweit. Die Hoffnung ist, tiefgreifende, langanhaltende Veranderungen bei psychischen Erkrankungen zu ermoglichen. Die Studie, an der Robin teilnimmt, wird jedoch mit gesunden Probandinnen und Probanden durchgefuhrt.Robin trifft Sylvia Kahlo, die als Kind beide Elternteile verloren hat und in der Folge immer wieder mit Depressionen und tiefen Traumata zu kampfen hatte. Erst mithilfe einer MDMA-gestutzten Psychotherapie fand sie Zugang zu den verdrangten Gefuhlen.
